qs.en: The fire and the explosion occurred simultaneously in the building.

qs.en: The two planes took off simultaneously from the adjacent runways.

qs.en: The dog is gnawing a bone in the garden.

qs.en: The doctor says you have broken a bone in your foot.

qs.en: The human skeleton is made up of two hundred and six bones.

qs.en: The bones of the human body protect the internal organs.

qs.en: The vet examines the bone of the dog's paw.
